data.name: Azeem
data.gender_notes: Azeem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azeem is an Arabic name that signifies greatness, grandeur, or magnificence. It is often used to describe something or someone of high esteem or reverence. The name Azeem carries the meaning “Great, magnificent, glorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azeem usually hope their child will grow to embody great, magnificent, glorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the word 'Azeem' is used to describe the reward or punishment on the Day of Judgment, indicating its association with grandeur and majesty.
data.etymology: Azeem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great, magnificent, glorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeem total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عظيم
in_arabic.meaning: عظيم تعريف - كبير، جليل، و عظیم الشأن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عظيم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عظم' يدل على العظمة و الكبر. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة 'وَكَانَ عَزِيزًا عَظِيمًا'، الآية ٢٦٧. يعني الشخص العظيم في الشأن و المكانة، و هو من أسماء الله الحسنى.

in_urdu.name: عظیم
in_urdu.meaning: عظیم مطلب - بڑا، جلیل، اور عظیم الشان
in_urdu.long_meaning: عظیم نام عربی جڑ 'عظم' سے نکلا ہے جو عظمت اور بڑائی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں سورة آل عمران 'وَكَانَ عَزِيزًا عَظِيمًا'، الآية ٥٩. یہ نام فرد کی عظیم شان اور مقام کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور یہ اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़ीम
in_hindi.meaning: अज़ीम अर्थ - बड़ा, महान, और उच्च सम्मान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीम नाम अरबी मूल 'अज़म' से लिया गया है, जो महानता और बड़ेपन को दर्शाता है। कुरआन में सूरा अल-बक़रा 'وَكَانَ عَزِيزًا عَظِيمًا'، आयत २६७. यह नाम व्यक्ति की महान स्थिति और गरिमा को इंगित करता है, और यह अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है।

in_pashto.name: عظیم
in_pashto.meaning: عظیم معنی - لوی، جلیل، او عظیم الشان
in_pashto.long_meaning: عظیم نوم د عربي جڑ 'عظم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د عظمت او لویوالي څرګندوي. په قرآن کريم کې سورة البقرة 'وَكَانَ عَزِيزًا عَظِيمًا'، الآية ٢٦٧. دا نوم د سړي د عظیم شان او مقام ښودلې، او دا د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی.

in_english.name: Azeem
in_english.meaning: Azeem meaning - great, magnificent, and of high esteem
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azeem originates from the Arabic root 'ʿ-z-m', signifying greatness and grandeur. Referenced in the Quran, Surah Al-Baqarah 'وَكَانَ عَزِيزًا عَظِيمًا', verse 267. It denotes someone of immense respect, high status, and majesty. Azeem is also one of the beautiful names of Allah, reflecting divine attributes of grandeur and supremacy.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عظیم (a-zheem)

It carries an impressive and majestic aura that adds to the prestige and respect of the person bearing the name. In Arab societies, giving a child such a noble name is seen as an investment in their future. It is a powerful reminder to strive for excellence and greatness in all aspects of life.

It encourages us to recognize the enormity of God's mercy, power, and wisdom. The name inspires us to cultivate a deep sense of awe and reverence towards Him. It challenges us to live up to His greatness by striving for excellence in our actions, character, and devotion. Ultimately, the name Azeem serves as a constant reminder of the grandeur of the divine and the potential for greatness within us.
